purpose: Make every Guide exhaust safe same-turn internal work before handing the human the canonical /wc wake prompt, and always give an evidence-based approximate worker count before asking the human to return.

guide_execution_law.rule: Do not reply merely because the next external wake is obvious. Continue safe same-turn Guide/repository work until no additional grounded reversible action remains that can materially improve worker yield, routing, measurement, product value, continuity or verification.
stop_only_when: the remaining next step requires the human to externally launch /wc chats because unattended wake is still unproven
a genuine human decision, privacy, irreversible action, Human Acceptance or unsupported external capability boundary is reached
all remaining work is already durably owned by another actor and duplication would be harmful
no grounded materially useful same-turn action remains
forbidden_early_stops: saying the canary is ready while a safe multiplicative fix is still available
deferring a repository/CI/projection repair that can be completed in the same turn
asking the human to choose worker class, variant, project or routing when the allocator/Guide can derive it
guide_execution_law.background_truth: This requires maximum safe work before the reply; it does not imply background execution after the reply.

launch_estimator.no_blind_exactness: If runtime occupancy is stale, still provide an approximate bounded canary count from fresh frontier + measured funnel/sample gaps, clearly marked approximate. Do not withhold the count merely because exact occupancy is unavailable.

strategy_sample_pressure.rule: For a represented class with a uniquely underrepresented variant, sample_gap = min_independent_workers_per_variant - current_explicit_experimental_workers. attempts_for_gap = ceil(sample_gap / max(0.20, authority_rate * explicit_exam_rate)). Derived launch rows never count toward the gap.

launch_estimator.fresh_runtime_adjustment: When runtime is fresh, subtract clearly active authority-backed capacity only when the runtime/scoreboard clocks are contemporaneous enough to avoid double counting; never reduce below the minimum needed for the active sample/value gate unless active workers are already filling it.
launch_estimator.final_rule: If integrity_smoke_override is ACTIVE, recommend its bounded smoke count first. Otherwise recommended ≈ clamp(max(frontier_target, attempts_for_gap, minimum useful canary),10,20); later Guides may exceed 20 only with fresh evidence of broader independent claimable demand and acceptable waste.

current_recommendation_example.why: Fresh-launch integrity smoke is PASS. Resume the ordinary bounded estimator: fresh compact frontier count 13 × 1.25 => ceil 17; keep the guarded v3.30 prompt and resident 3/6/8 worker law active.

response_contract.first_visible_block: The first copyable block in the final human response must be the exact guarded canonical /wc invocation from CURRENT_MISSION_V1.json. Do not paraphrase it and do not put analysis before it.
response_contract.bottom_mini_message: End with one compact line telling the human approximately how many identical /wc chats to launch before returning to /g, plus only the shortest reason needed.
response_contract.required_bottom_shape: MANDÁ ~<N> /wc Y VOLVÉ A /g · <short evidence reason>
response_contract.do_not_add: Do not add worker-specific routing, codes, classes, variants or project instructions unless a true authority boundary explicitly requires them.
guard_markers_required: PROHIBIDO reutilizar identidad o resultado histórico

integrity_smoke_override.rationale: A new human launch replayed a historical v3.28 closed worker without creating a fresh beacon. Canonical handoff is now self-guarding in the human message. Validate the v3.30 anti-replay identity gate on 3 distinct ordinary resident launches before restoring the normal 10–20 scale estimator.
integrity_smoke_override.on_pass: Disable this override and return to the ordinary frontier/sample estimator.
